doctor.description: Verify Deno 2.9.6, Quarto 1.10.18, uv 0.11.32, git-flow 2.1.0 and its shared config, lychee 0.24.2, Node 22 or later, the Spec Kit, ShellCheck, doc-regions and wiki-consistency environments and locked dependencies

tasks.test:workflow: deno test --frozen --cached-only --no-prompt --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-sys --allow-run scripts/workflow_test.ts scripts/workflow_plan_test.ts scripts/workflow_verify_test.ts scripts/workflow_graph_test.ts scripts/workflow_skills_test.ts
tasks.lint:shell: git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- '*.sh' scripts/git-hooks scripts/git-flow-hooks ':(exclude).specify/**' | xargs -0 uv run --project tools/shellcheck --frozen --offline --no-sync shellcheck
tasks.typecheck: deno check --frozen scripts/validate_plugins.ts scripts/clean_architecture.ts scripts/workflow.ts scripts/docs.ts scripts/constitution_version.ts
tasks.test:backfire: (test -f packages/backfire/.venv/bin/python && test -f packages/backfire/.venv/bin/pytest || (echo 'Missing Backfire pytest environment. Run deno task backfire:install.' >&2; exit 1)) && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --project packages/backfire --frozen --offline --no-sync pytest packages/backfire/tests -m 'not slow'
tasks.test:backfire-slow: (test -f packages/backfire/.venv/bin/python && test -f packages/backfire/.venv/bin/pytest || (echo 'Missing Backfire pytest environment. Run deno task backfire:install.' >&2; exit 1)) && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --project packages/backfire --frozen --offline --no-sync pytest packages/backfire/tests -m slow

doc-regions:check.description: Check mechanical regions and local links in the target documents, offline and without writing
doc-regions:check.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --project packages/doc-regions --frozen --offline --no-sync doc-regions check scripts/doc_regions.toml

doc-regions:update.description: Regenerate stale mechanical regions in the target documents
doc-regions:update.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --project packages/doc-regions --frozen --offline --no-sync doc-regions update scripts/doc_regions.toml

doc-regions:prepare.description: Print backfire requests for the agent regions before a develop merge review (pass --base and --max-evidence-chars)
doc-regions:prepare.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --project packages/doc-regions --frozen --offline --no-sync doc-regions prepare scripts/doc_regions.toml

doc-regions:audit.description: Run MemoryLint's read-only audit on AGENTS.md and the constitution
doc-regions:audit.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --project packages/doc-regions --frozen --no-sync doc-regions audit scripts/doc_regions.toml

tasks.wiki-consistency:install: uv sync --locked --project packages/backfire --extra education && uv sync --locked --project packages/wiki-consistency && npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --prefix packages/wiki-consistency
tasks.test:wiki-consistency: (test -f packages/wiki-consistency/.venv/bin/pytest || (echo 'Missing wiki-consistency environment. Run deno task wiki-consistency:install.' >&2; exit 1)) && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --project packages/wiki-consistency --frozen --offline --no-sync pytest packages/wiki-consistency/tests
tasks.test:doc-regions: (test -f packages/doc-regions/.venv/bin/pytest || (echo 'Missing doc-regions environment. Run uv sync --locked --project packages/doc-regions.' >&2; exit 1)) && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --project packages/doc-regions --frozen --offline --no-sync pytest -p no:cacheprovider packages/doc-regions/tests scripts/doc_sources_test.py
tasks.format: deno run --frozen --cached-only --no-prompt --allow-read --allow-env --allow-run npm:@biomejs/biome@2.5.14 format --write . && deno fmt .github/ orca.yaml
tasks.format:check: deno run --frozen --cached-only --no-prompt --allow-read --allow-env --allow-run npm:@biomejs/biome@2.5.14 format . && deno fmt --check .github/ orca.yaml
